title: Authentic TOPS-20 boot debugging
summary: Operational rules for advancing the reconstructed KL10 only through guest states supported by the architecture, the monitor source and reproducible replay.
procedure: Start from the latest qualified checkpoint, never from a downstream state already tainted by a known impossible event.
Open kl10.current-continuation and confirm the current qualified baseline, WIP boundary and forbidden stale futures before replay.
At each new boundary record PC/section, instruction, relevant ACs, FLAGS, APR/PI state, pager registers, UPT frame and the exact memory translation involved.
Identify the guest source label before implementing an unsupported instruction or changing machine semantics.
Add a focused regression for the architectural behavior, then replay the authentic guest path.
Run the wider core suite before qualifying a checkpoint or package.
invariants: No synthetic memory pages to make the guest progress.
No forced register values or hand-edited page tables as a promoted solution.
Observer/debugger reads may be more forgiving than CPU cycles, but they must not mutate guest state.
Machine capacity, page existence and page contents are separate concepts.
A downstream convergence is evidence only until the complete upstream path is qualified.
